name: Fetch
idea: A proud black hound trots up with your parcel swinging from its mouth on a loop of string: CNX fetches it and brings it to your door.
why: Everyone, child or adult, reads 'fetch' in one glance, and a black dog in a yellow collar carrying a yellow parcel is a picture people retell as 'the courier with the dog'.
risks: Sunflower with near-black is also worn by Yandex Go and by tool brands, the carved details drop out below about 32 px so favicons rely on the silhouette alone, and a dog may feel too playful to some conservative B2B clients.
